channel.title: Her View From Home - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Her View From Home (herviewfromhome.com)

item.title: Leaving my marriage was my only choice
item.description: I never expected to get divorced, but when my. husband was unfaithful and it became clear I needed to leave, I realized God was with me.

item.title: A poem for moms in sick season
item.description: When the kids are sick again, a mother steps up. Illness is hard on a household but the love of a mom soothes everyone.

item.title: I'm becoming someone new in my 40s
item.description: In my 40s, I'm finding time to discover someone new: myself. This midlife part of motherhood and marriage is about renewal.

item.title: Big brothers and little sisters share a special bond
item.description: A big brother is his little sister's first friend and the bond they share from the very beginning is sacred and special.

item.title: It's been a beautiful year with you, rainbow baby
item.description: To my rainbow baby on her first birthday, we knew how much we wanted you, but we couldn't have dreamed how much we needed you.

item.title: We meet our daughter where she is—and there's always beauty there
item.description: For our daughter with autism, progress looks like the little things and meeting her where she is to appreciate the joy.

item.title: My childhood was a blueprint, but I am the architect now
item.description: My childhood provided a blueprint I'm not going to follow for my own home because I'm breaking the cycle and choosing love.

item.title: I want my daughter to see me facing my fears so she can face hers one day
item.description: When we face our fears, it shows strength and bravery, the kind I want my young daughter to learn from me.

item.title: Raising teenagers is not for the faint of heart
item.description: As my teenagers get older, it's harder to open up about the struggles of this part of motherhood but I trust God with them.

item.title: The perfect mom does not exist
item.description: You are not a perfect mom and the truth is there is no such thing. Motherhood is about being present, not perfect.

item.title: Watching your children grow up together is pure magic
item.description: When you're raising siblings that are two peas in a pod, it's pure magic to watch their bond grow and deepen as they get older.

item.title: I'm trusting God with the little girl I once held
item.description: The little girl who was once my sweet baby is growing into a teenager and I'm trusting God with the young woman she's becoming.
